# bool / config

The **bool** type's config capability: the `boolField` factory (core) and the
checkbox renderer contributed to `config-v2.fields.renderer` (web).

Relocated from `config_v2/plugins/fields/plugins/primitives`. The factory builds
a config_v2 `FieldDef<boolean>` carrying the canonical `fields/` bool token
(`@plugins/fields/plugins/bool/core`, id `"bool"`); dispatch is by id string.
`FieldHeader` comes from the slot owner
(`@plugins/config_v2/plugins/fields/web`).
